## Why we forget most of what we read

Source: https://longread.example/why-we-forget

- The problem is rarely comprehension; it is that nothing asks us to retrieve what we read. (Yellow: key idea)
    - Good opening line for my essay intro.
- Pulling an idea back out of memory, even imperfectly, strengthens it far more than reading it again. (Mint: evidence)
